nodes.original_target: A rational density matrix with (3,4,5)-triangle observables has S_CHSH = 14/5 > 2 while the four pair distributions have full support and admit no positive common joint law (full-support Bell tables require positivity, not support alone).

Normalization of the Born readout is idempotent and ray quotients are classified (normalize_idempotent, ray_quotient_classification) over the stated finite/rational domain; the normalization step is redundant after ray quotienting.

The frame polytope {f in R^18 : f >= 0, Af = 1} of the Cabello configuration has exactly 146 half-integral extreme valuations; none has a PSD real-symmetric representative H_f (26 have smallest eigenvalue -1/2; 120 have smallest eigenvalue > -1/4).

The 18 Cabello integer rays with 9 orthogonal tetrads admit no Int-valued 0/1-type frame assignment (odd count 9 = 2k has no solution: cabello_parity_obstruction); frame additivity and bounded nonnegativity do not force PSD (frame_function_additivity_not_force_psd).

Declared carrier: cyclotomic fields Q(zeta_n) with directed tower law (m | n gives Q(zeta_m) <= Q(zeta_n)), declared target conductor LCM 120 (distinct conductors 1,2,3,4,5,8,12; 23 targets), Born weights |psi_j|^2 in the real subfield Q(zeta_n)^+. The colimit Q^ab is named but not constructed; Kronecker-Weber is DECLARED.

Over F2 the measurement-scenario cochain complex satisfies d^2 = 0 (differential_squares_to_zero); the Cabello scenario has odd tetrad parity so no global section (x1_has_no_global_section); Peres-Mermin incidence rank 8 with total-parity obstruction. Parity obstruction is a finite exact fact about declared scenarios.

Bundle of inputs every finite-QM result in this fragment consumes: scalar field (Q(i) or Q(zeta_n)), Hilbert/inner-product carrier, positive cone and effects, trace/Born pairing, tensor composition, declared channels, and (where used) a unitary step or time. Declared, not derived.

For an algebraic spectrum, von Neumann entropy is zero iff the state is pure (entropy_zero_iff_pure) and positive for mixed spectra (mixed_entropy_positive); transcendence of mixed entropy follows from the Baker hypothesis supplied as a hypothesis. Rust gives exact rational spectra and cited-anchor rational interval enclosures with integer Renyi power sums.

Born uniqueness of the quadratic form needs imported Hilbert space, projection lattices and Gleason-type assumptions, with dimension n >= 3; Gleason frame additivity at n >= 3 is verified only over orthogonal frames of specific finite ray sets. The three-label cardinality surrogate (3 <= |Q|) is false on Bool; the unit-effect contract already has two disagreeing pairings.
